title: Boiled Potato, fresh, peel not eaten, with butter

content.title: About
content.content: Boiled potato is a dish made from fresh potatoes that are boiled, peeled, and served with butter. Potatoes are a major source of carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals, while butter adds a rich flavor and aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Potatoes were introduced to Europe from South America in the 16th century.
There are over 4,000 potato varieties, but high‑starch types are preferred for boiling.
Boiled potatoes without the skin retain most of their vitamin C if not overcooked.
Butter added to potatoes enhances the absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K).
In Russia boiled potatoes are traditionally served with sour cream, but butter is a more neutral option.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Potatoes are rich in complex carbohydrates that provide sustained energy.

items.title: High in vitamin C
items.content: Boiled potatoes retain a significant amount of vitamin C, which supports immunity and antioxidant protection.

items.title: Contains potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: The fiber in potatoes aids regular bowel movements.

items.title: Improves vitamin absorption
items.content: Butter supplies the fat needed for better absorption of the fat‑soluble vitamins present in potatoes.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Potatoes can raise blood sugar quickly, which is important for people with diabetes to monitor.

items.title: Calorie content
items.content: Adding butter increases the overall calorie count of the dish.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be intolerant or allergic to the milk proteins in butter.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: When salt is added, its amount should be controlled to avoid excessive sodium intake.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve boiled potatoes hot, drizzled with a small amount of butter. They can be added to salads, used as a side dish for meat or fish, or mashed.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep boiled potatoes in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3–4 days. Store butter separately to prevent the dish from becoming overly soft.
